stem: Yogesh draws parallelogram $ABCD$ with base $AB=12\,\mathrm{cm}$ and corresponding perpendicular height $5\,\mathrm{cm}$. Side $AD$ measures $6\,\mathrm{cm}$.

parts.text: Which claim correctly gives the area of parallelogram $ABCD$?
Give one reason for your choice that uses the base and its corresponding height.

part_answers.answer: Area equals base times corresponding perpendicular height: use AB=12 cm with height 5 cm, not the slanted side 6 cm.

teacher.key_rationale: Any side may be the base only with its perpendicular height. Here AB=12 cm pairs with height 5 cm, so area=60 cm². Using AD=6 cm as height is wrong.
